newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 29.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the benchmark Kuala Lumpur Composite Index jumped 14.45 points or 1.34 percent to 1,096.33, helped by local institutional buying.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5095/05 a dollar at around 1000 GMT on Wednesday against 2.5145/55 previously.
* National carrier Malaysia Airline expected to release full-year results after market close on Thursday. Poll of analysts see higher MAS net profit of 261 million ringgit.
* "With other bourses not showing much change, I think we'll have a quiet day today," said an institutional dealer with a local brokerage firm.
* Analysts say the Composite Index, which has been on a recovery track from over a month of selling, could face resistance at 1,100.
* Among individual stocks, Measurex Corp Bhd, a precision engineering firm, is scheduled to list its shares on the Second Board at an offer price of 7.00 ringgit per share.
* Companies requesting stock suspensions during Thursday's session are plastics maker Sanda Plastics Industries Bhd and construction and timber firm Innovest Bhd .
